title: How Wall Street banks, from JPMorgan to Citi, are using AI
excerpt: Wall Street banks like JPMorgan, Citi, and Goldman Sachs are investing billions in AI, reshaping workflows and culture.
content_html:
Everything we know about how biggest Wall Street banks are using AI

By Alice Tecotzky

You're currently following this author! Want to unfollow? Unsubscribe via the link in your email.

and Michelle Abrego

You're currently following this author! Want to unfollow? Unsubscribe via the link in your email.

Wall Street is betting big on, and pouring billions into, AI, as big banks jostle to remain ahead of the technological curve.

Generative AI is impacting everything from trading floors to back offices, workflows to workplace culture. It's changing what it means to be a software engineer, how junior bankers stand out, and even the roles inside the C-suite. The shift, it seems, is only just beginning.

Yet for all the proclaimed advancements, analysts continue to pepper executives with questions about returns and safety, as concerns mount across industries about whether the gargantuan spending on AI is justified. And though harnessing the technology is table stakes at this point — JPMorgan CEO Jamie Dimon said his bank doesn't "uniquely benefit from AI" since everyone is now using it — gradations still exist between firms' strategies.

Here's what we know about how Wall Street's biggest banks are embracing AI.

JPMorgan Chase

The nation's biggest bank is putting a lot of effort toward making sure it's an early mover in AI, with the help of a nearly $20 billion annual technology budget. Dimon has previously said he's out to win the AI arms race, and he thinks JPMorgan's $2 billion AI investment has already matched its cost in savings.

The firm is keeping close tabs on how its tens of thousands of engineers are using AI, Business Insider reported. One dashboard tracks how much developers use GitHub Copilot and classifies them into "light," "heavy," or "non" users. The bank has also updated objectives for its engineers, who are now expected to "drive excellence" by adopting AI, according to posts on the company intranet.

In July, the firm's AI chief, Teresa Heitsenrether, announced her retirement after four decades at the bank, reshuffling technology leadership. JPMorgan said at the time that it was restructuring its firmwide chief data and analytics office as it transitions from focusing on AI infrastructure to business initiatives. JPMorgan reorganized its commercial and investment bank in February to "maximize the impact of AI," according to an internal memo reviewed by Business Insider. Each major business in the division now reports to Guy Halamish, the newly named chief operating officer of the CIB.

Dimon said on a second-quarter earnings call that his bank already has almost 1,000 use cases, from fraud protection to marketing to note-taking. The bank has rolled out its proprietary genAI platform to more than 200,000 employees — seeking to reengineer workflows for everyone from coders to portfolio managers.

The bank's AI efforts are impacting those beyond its immediate workforce. JPMorgan Chase's asset management unit announced plans to discontinue a long-held practice of using external proxy advisors for shareholder voting in the US this year. In place of external human advisors, the firm is launching an in-house AI platform, called Proxy IQ, to support shareholder decisions.

Goldman Sachs

Goldman put $6 billion behind its technology spend this year, but David Solomon, the bank's CEO, said in October he wished it were more. He would like to be at least $8 billion, but "I can't afford it because I've got to deliver returns."

Solomon encouraged this year's interns to experiment with AI tools "to enhance your teams' workflows" in his annual letter; the rest of the firm got a definitive statement about AI's impact in October, when a memo went out to employees announcing the third iteration of the cross-bank initiative, OneGS. The memo said the plan would leverage AI to drive efficiency at the firm, slow hiring, and result in a "limited reduction" of roles.

Goldman, like its peers, has been rolling out tools to all employees, including an internal AI assistant. Marco Argenti, the chief information officer, told Business Insider that he's more interested in measuring teams' velocity with AI tools than individual usage. The bank has been working with Anthropic to develop AI agents that can automate a number of internal functions, Marco told CNBC in February. The project focused on accounting for trades and transactions and on client onboarding, he said.

Citigroup

Citi is trying to win the AI game on employee buy-in above all else. Tim Ryan, the firm's tech chief who oversees the bank's $12 billion tech budget, told Business Insider that he believes firms need a mix of "metrics and pride." Citi has taken a bottom-up approach to embedding AI throughout its lines of business, with 4,000 employees trained as AI stewards.

Nearly 90% of employees at Citi are using AI tools, CEO Jane Fraser said on the bank's 2026 earnings call. This year, the bank has unveiled an AI wealth advisor and begun to scale the use of agents.

Unlike some competitors, Citi does not measure employees' granular AI usage; instead, it measures "the big things" and encourages employees to use the lowest-cost model that meets their needs.

In June 2025, the bank doubled down on its AI ambitions, appointing new leadership to helm its tech transformation.

Wells Fargo

Business Insider spoke to Saul Van Beurden, the bank's Head of AI, about how AI is fueling the bank's post-asset cap growth.

The firm uses a "hub and spoke" model for its AI architecture, with Van Beurden's small team as the central hub and each business line's generative AI lead as a spoke. AI agents, he said, are becoming central to some of the highest-impact use cases.

When Business Insider spoke to Van Beurden in March, the bank wasn't mandating that its employees use AI.

In July, Wells Fargo announced an "AI teammate" for its financial advisors, which it says will help increase daily activity. CEO Charles Scharf has previously said that generative AI tools have already made the bank's engineers up to 35% more productive.

Wells Fargo also tapped Amazon Web Services executive Faraz Shafiq to lead AI products and solutions at the beginning of 2026, the latest in a string of high-profile tech poachings on Wall Street.

Bank of America

Bank of America's tech ambitions were backed by a $13 billion tech budget in 2025, and CEO Brian Moynihan has said AI is already embedded across the firm, from consumer banking to institutional clients.

More than 300 AI and machine learning cases have been approved at the firm, and at least 34 generative AI use cases are fully deployed, the bank said in a second-quarter earnings presentation in July. Employees in wealth, investment banking, and engineering are among those who have specialized tools.

Clients have interacted with Bank of America's virtual assistant, Erica, more than 3.2 billion times since the tool launched in 2018, the bank said in March.

Moynihan shed light on some of the models that use AI at the bank when speaking at a February conference. There is, he said, a model that puts out a daily markets report, and others that help draft pitch books.

Morgan Stanley

Morgan Stanley has had a years-long partnership with OpenAI and has equipped financial advisors with generative AI since 2024.

CFO Sharon Yeshaya lifted the curtain on some of the firm's progress on AI during an earnings call last year. She highlighted DevGen.AI, a tool that, from January to June, had saved developers more than 280,000 hours, or 11,666 days, they would have previously dedicated to deciphering outdated code, Business Insider previously reported.

Parable, an interactive tool that analyzes and summarizes data, and LeadIQ, an AI-powered lead distribution platform that matches users of its workplace and self-directed platforms to the bank's financial advisors, were also spotlighted in the call.

A 2025 survey of Morgan Stanley's interns also gave a peek into just how popular and useful AI has been for the industry's youngest cohort. ChatGPT is their favorite tool by far, with 72% of Morgan Stanley's interns saying they use it daily or several times a week. The bank was early to have a partnership with ChatGPT-maker OpenAI.

sentences.en: In place of external human advisors, the firm is launching an in-house AI platform, called Proxy IQ, to support shareholder decisions.
sentences.zh: 该公司正在推出一个名为 Proxy IQ 的内部人工智能平台来取代外部人类顾问，以支持股东决策。

blocks.html_en: Goldman Sachs

sentences.en: Goldman Sachs
sentences.zh: 高盛

sentences.en: Goldman Sachs' David Solomon.
sentences.zh: 高盛的大卫·所罗门。

sentences.en: Michael Kovac
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·科瓦奇

blocks.html_en: Goldman put $6 billion behind its technology spend this year, but David Solomon, the bank's CEO, said in October he wished it were more. He would like to be at least $8 billion, but "I can't afford it because I've got to deliver returns."

sentences.en: Goldman put $6 billion behind its technology spend this year, but David Solomon, the bank's CEO, said in October he wished it were more.
sentences.zh: 高盛今年在技术支出上投入了 60 亿美元，但该银行首席执行官戴维·所罗门 (David Solomon) 在 10 月份表示，他希望投入更多。

sentences.en: He would like to be at least $8 billion, but "I can't afford it because I've got to deliver returns."
sentences.zh: 他希望自己的资产至少达到 80 亿美元，但“我负担不起，因为我必须提供回报。”

blocks.html_en: Solomon encouraged this year's interns to experiment with AI tools "to enhance your teams' workflows" in his annual letter; the rest of the firm got a definitive statement about AI's impact in October, when a memo went out to employees announcing the third iteration of the cross-bank initiative, OneGS. The memo said the plan would leverage AI to drive efficiency at the firm, slow hiring, and result in a "limited reduction" of roles.

sentences.en: Solomon encouraged this year's interns to experiment with AI tools "to enhance your teams' workflows" in his annual letter; the rest of the firm got a definitive statement about AI's impact in October, when a memo went out to employees announcing the third iteration of the cross-bank initiative, OneGS.
sentences.zh: 所罗门在他的年度信中鼓励今年的实习生尝试人工智能工具，“以增强团队的工作流程”；公司其他部门在 10 月份得到了关于人工智能影响的明确声明，当时向员工发出了一份备忘录，宣布跨银行计划的第三次迭代 OneGS。

sentences.en: The memo said the plan would leverage AI to drive efficiency at the firm, slow hiring, and result in a "limited reduction" of roles.
sentences.zh: 备忘录称，该计划将利用人工智能来提高公司效率，减缓招聘速度，并导致“有限减少”职位。

blocks.html_en: Goldman, like its peers, has been rolling out tools to all employees, including an internal AI assistant. Marco Argenti, the chief information officer, told Business Insider that he's more interested in measuring teams' velocity with AI tools than individual usage. The bank has been working with Anthropic to develop AI agents that can automate a number of internal functions, Marco told CNBC in February. The project focused on accounting for trades and transactions and on client onboarding, he said.

sentences.en: Goldman, like its peers, has been rolling out tools to all employees, including an internal AI assistant.
sentences.zh: 与同行一样，高盛一直在向所有员工推出工具，包括内部人工智能助理。

sentences.en: Marco Argenti, the chief information officer, told Business Insider that he's more interested in measuring teams' velocity with AI tools than individual usage.
sentences.zh: 首席信息官 Marco Argenti 告诉《商业内幕》，他对衡量团队使用人工智能工具的速度比个人使用情况更感兴趣。

sentences.en: The bank has been working with Anthropic to develop AI agents that can automate a number of internal functions, Marco told CNBC in February.
sentences.zh: Marco 在 2 月份告诉 CNBC，该银行一直在与 Anthropic 合作开发可以自动化许多内部功能的人工智能代理。

sentences.en: The project focused on accounting for trades and transactions and on client onboarding, he said.
sentences.zh: 他说，该项目的重点是交易和交易的会计以及客户入职。

blocks.html_en: Citigroup

sentences.en: Citigroup
sentences.zh: 花旗集团

sentences.en: Citi CEO Jane Fraser.
sentences.zh: 花旗首席执行官简·弗雷泽。

sentences.en: NICHOLAS KAMM/Getty Images
sentences.zh: 尼古拉斯·卡姆/盖蒂图片社

blocks.html_en: Citi is trying to win the AI game on employee buy-in above all else. Tim Ryan, the firm's tech chief who oversees the bank's $12 billion tech budget, told Business Insider that he believes firms need a mix of "metrics and pride." Citi has taken a bottom-up approach to embedding AI throughout its lines of business, with 4,000 employees trained as AI stewards.

sentences.en: Citi is trying to win the AI game on employee buy-in above all else.
sentences.zh: 花旗正试图在人工智能游戏中赢得员工的支持高于一切。

sentences.en: Tim Ryan, the firm's tech chief who oversees the bank's $12 billion tech budget, told Business Insider that he believes firms need a mix of "metrics and pride."
sentences.zh: 该公司负责监督该银行 120 亿美元技术预算的技术主管蒂姆·瑞安 (Tim Ryan) 告诉《商业内幕》，他认为公司需要“指标和自豪感”的结合。

sentences.en: Citi has taken a bottom-up approach to embedding AI throughout its lines of business, with 4,000 employees trained as AI stewards.
sentences.zh: 花旗采取自下而上的方法将人工智能嵌入其整个业务线，4,000 名员工接受了人工智能管理员的培训。

blocks.html_en: Nearly 90% of employees at Citi are using AI tools, CEO Jane Fraser said on the bank's 2026 earnings call. This year, the bank has unveiled an AI wealth advisor and begun to scale the use of agents.

sentences.en: Nearly 90% of employees at Citi are using AI tools, CEO Jane Fraser said on the bank's 2026 earnings call.
sentences.zh: 花旗首席执行官简·弗雷泽 (Jane Fraser) 在该行 2026 年财报电话会议上表示，花旗近 90% 的员工都在使用人工智能工具。

sentences.en: This year, the bank has unveiled an AI wealth advisor and begun to scale the use of agents.
sentences.zh: 今年，该银行推出了人工智能财富顾问，并开始扩大代理人的使用。

blocks.html_en: Unlike some competitors, Citi does not measure employees' granular AI usage; instead, it measures "the big things" and encourages employees to use the lowest-cost model that meets their needs.

sentences.en: Unlike some competitors, Citi does not measure employees' granular AI usage; instead, it measures "the big things" and encourages employees to use the lowest-cost model that meets their needs.
sentences.zh: 与一些竞争对手不同，花旗不会衡量员工的人工智能使用情况；相反，它衡量“大事”并鼓励员工使用满足其需求的最低成本模式。

blocks.html_en: In June 2025, the bank doubled down on its AI ambitions, appointing new leadership to helm its tech transformation.

sentences.en: In June 2025, the bank doubled down on its AI ambitions, appointing new leadership to helm its tech transformation.
sentences.zh: 2025 年 6 月，该银行加倍坚定其人工智能雄心，任命新的领导层来掌管其技术转型。

blocks.html_en: Wells Fargo

sentences.en: Wells Fargo
sentences.zh: 富国银行

sentences.en: Charles Scharf, CEO of Wells Fargo Michael M.
sentences.zh: 查尔斯·沙夫（Charles Scharf），富国银行首席执行官迈克尔·M.

sentences.en: Santiago/Getty Images
sentences.zh: 圣地亚哥/盖蒂图片社

blocks.html_en: Business Insider spoke to Saul Van Beurden, the bank's Head of AI, about how AI is fueling the bank's post-asset cap growth.

sentences.en: Business Insider spoke to Saul Van Beurden, the bank's Head of AI, about how AI is fueling the bank's post-asset cap growth.
sentences.zh: 《商业内幕》采访了该银行人工智能主管 Saul Van Beurden，了解人工智能如何推动该银行资产上限后的增长。

blocks.html_en: The firm uses a "hub and spoke" model for its AI architecture, with Van Beurden's small team as the central hub and each business line's generative AI lead as a spoke. AI agents, he said, are becoming central to some of the highest-impact use cases.

sentences.en: The firm uses a "hub and spoke" model for its AI architecture, with Van Beurden's small team as the central hub and each business line's generative AI lead as a spoke.
sentences.zh: 该公司的人工智能架构采用“中心辐射”模型，以 Van Beurden 的小团队作为中心枢纽，每个业务线的生成式人工智能主管作为辐射。

sentences.en: AI agents, he said, are becoming central to some of the highest-impact use cases.
sentences.zh: 他说，人工智能代理正在成为一些影响最大的用例的核心。

blocks.html_en: When Business Insider spoke to Van Beurden in March, the bank wasn't mandating that its employees use AI.

sentences.en: When Business Insider spoke to Van Beurden in March, the bank wasn't mandating that its employees use AI.
sentences.zh: 当《商业内幕》三月份采访范伯登时，该银行并没有强制要求员工使用人工智能。

blocks.html_en: In July, Wells Fargo announced an "AI teammate" for its financial advisors, which it says will help increase daily activity. CEO Charles Scharf has previously said that generative AI tools have already made the bank's engineers up to 35% more productive.

sentences.en: In July, Wells Fargo announced an "AI teammate" for its financial advisors, which it says will help increase daily activity.
sentences.zh: 7 月，富国银行宣布为其财务顾问配备“人工智能队友”，据称这将有助于增加日常活动。

sentences.en: CEO Charles Scharf has previously said that generative AI tools have already made the bank's engineers up to 35% more productive.
sentences.zh: 首席执行官 Charles Scharf 此前曾表示，生成式 AI 工具已经使该银行工程师的工作效率提高了 35%。

blocks.html_en: Wells Fargo also tapped Amazon Web Services executive Faraz Shafiq to lead AI products and solutions at the beginning of 2026, the latest in a string of high-profile tech poachings on Wall Street.

sentences.en: Wells Fargo also tapped Amazon Web Services executive Faraz Shafiq to lead AI products and solutions at the beginning of 2026, the latest in a string of high-profile tech poachings on Wall Street.
sentences.zh: 富国银行还在 2026 年初任命亚马逊网络服务高管 Faraz Shafiq 领导人工智能产品和解决方案，这是华尔街一系列备受瞩目的科技挖角事件中的最新一起。

blocks.html_en: Bank of America

sentences.en: Bank of America
sentences.zh: 美国银行

sentences.en: Bank of America's Brian Moynihan.
sentences.zh: 美国银行的布莱恩·莫伊尼汉。

sentences.en: John Lamparski/Getty Images
sentences.zh: 约翰·兰帕尔斯基/盖蒂图片社

blocks.html_en: Bank of America's tech ambitions were backed by a $13 billion tech budget in 2025, and CEO Brian Moynihan has said AI is already embedded across the firm, from consumer banking to institutional clients.

sentences.en: Bank of America's tech ambitions were backed by a $13 billion tech budget in 2025, and CEO Brian Moynihan has said AI is already embedded across the firm, from consumer banking to institutional clients.
sentences.zh: 美国银行的科技雄心得到了 2025 年 130 亿美元科技预算的支持，首席执行官布莱恩·莫伊尼汉 (Brian Moynihan) 表示，人工智能已经嵌入到整个公司，从消费者银行业务到机构客户。

blocks.html_en: More than 300 AI and machine learning cases have been approved at the firm, and at least 34 generative AI use cases are fully deployed, the bank said in a second-quarter earnings presentation in July. Employees in wealth, investment banking, and engineering are among those who have specialized tools.

sentences.en: More than 300 AI and machine learning cases have been approved at the firm, and at least 34 generative AI use cases are fully deployed, the bank said in a second-quarter earnings presentation in July.
sentences.zh: 该银行在 7 月份的第二季度财报中表示，该公司已批准 300 多个人工智能和机器学习案例，并且至少有 34 个生成式人工智能用例得到全面部署。

sentences.en: Employees in wealth, investment banking, and engineering are among those who have specialized tools.
sentences.zh: 财富、投资银行和工程领域的员工拥有专门的工具。

blocks.html_en: Clients have interacted with Bank of America's virtual assistant, Erica, more than 3.2 billion times since the tool launched in 2018, the bank said in March.

sentences.en: Clients have interacted with Bank of America's virtual assistant, Erica, more than 3.2 billion times since the tool launched in 2018, the bank said in March.
sentences.zh: 美国银行 3 月份表示，自 2018 年推出该工具以来，客户与该银行的虚拟助理 Erica 的互动次数已超过 32 亿次。

blocks.html_en: Moynihan shed light on some of the models that use AI at the bank when speaking at a February conference. There is, he said, a model that puts out a daily markets report, and others that help draft pitch books.

sentences.en: Moynihan shed light on some of the models that use AI at the bank when speaking at a February conference.
sentences.zh: 莫伊尼汉在 2 月份的一次会议上发表讲话时，阐述了该银行使用人工智能的一些模型。

sentences.en: There is, he said, a model that puts out a daily markets report, and others that help draft pitch books.
sentences.zh: 他说，有一个模型可以发布每日市场报告，还有其他模型可以帮助起草宣传手册。

blocks.html_en: Morgan Stanley

sentences.en: Morgan Stanley
sentences.zh: 摩根士丹利

sentences.en: Morgan Stanley CEO Ted Pick.
sentences.zh: 摩根士丹利首席执行官特德·皮克。

sentences.en: Jeenah Moon / Reuters
sentences.zh: 吉娜·穆恩/路透社

blocks.html_en: Morgan Stanley has had a years-long partnership with OpenAI and has equipped financial advisors with generative AI since 2024.

sentences.en: Morgan Stanley has had a years-long partnership with OpenAI and has equipped financial advisors with generative AI since 2024.
sentences.zh: 摩根士丹利与 OpenAI 有着多年的合作伙伴关系，并自 2024 年起为财务顾问配备了生成式 AI。

blocks.html_en: CFO Sharon Yeshaya lifted the curtain on some of the firm's progress on AI during an earnings call last year. She highlighted DevGen.AI, a tool that, from January to June, had saved developers more than 280,000 hours, or 11,666 days, they would have previously dedicated to deciphering outdated code, Business Insider previously reported.

sentences.en: CFO Sharon Yeshaya lifted the curtain on some of the firm's progress on AI during an earnings call last year.
sentences.zh: 首席财务官 Sharon Yeshaya 在去年的财报电话会议上揭开了该公司在人工智能方面取得的一些进展的帷幕。

sentences.en: She highlighted DevGen.AI, a tool that, from January to June, had saved developers more than 280,000 hours, or 11,666 days, they would have previously dedicated to deciphering outdated code, Business Insider previously reported.
sentences.zh: 据《商业内幕》此前报道，她重点介绍了 DevGen.AI，该工具从 1 月到 6 月为开发人员节省了超过 280,000 小时（即 11,666 天）的时间，而此前他们本该专门用于破译过时的代码。

blocks.html_en: Parable, an interactive tool that analyzes and summarizes data, and LeadIQ, an AI-powered lead distribution platform that matches users of its workplace and self-directed platforms to the bank's financial advisors, were also spotlighted in the call.

sentences.en: Parable, an interactive tool that analyzes and summarizes data, and LeadIQ, an AI-powered lead distribution platform that matches users of its workplace and self-directed platforms to the bank's financial advisors, were also spotlighted in the call.
sentences.zh: Parable（一种分析和总结数据的交互式工具）和 LeadIQ（一种人工智能驱动的潜在客户分配平台，可将其工作场所和自主平台的用户与银行的财务顾问进行匹配）也在电话会议中受到关注。

blocks.html_en: A 2025 survey of Morgan Stanley's interns also gave a peek into just how popular and useful AI has been for the industry's youngest cohort. ChatGPT is their favorite tool by far, with 72% of Morgan Stanley's interns saying they use it daily or several times a week. The bank was early to have a partnership with ChatGPT-maker OpenAI.

sentences.en: A 2025 survey of Morgan Stanley's interns also gave a peek into just how popular and useful AI has been for the industry's youngest cohort.
sentences.zh: 摩根士丹利 2025 年对实习生进行的一项调查也让我们了解了人工智能对于该行业最年轻的实习生来说是多么受欢迎和有用。

sentences.en: ChatGPT is their favorite tool by far, with 72% of Morgan Stanley's interns saying they use it daily or several times a week.
sentences.zh: ChatGPT 是他们迄今为止最喜欢的工具，72% 的摩根士丹利实习生表示他们每天或每周使用几次。

sentences.en: The bank was early to have a partnership with ChatGPT-maker OpenAI.
sentences.zh: 该银行很早就与 ChatGPT 制造商 OpenAI 建立了合作伙伴关系。

content_html_zh:
我们所知道的有关华尔街最大银行如何使用人工智能的一切

作者：Alice Tecotzky 您目前正在关注该作者！ 想要取消关注吗？ 通过电子邮件中的链接取消订阅。 和 Michelle Abrego 您目前正在关注该作者！ 想要取消关注吗？ 通过电子邮件中的链接取消订阅。

随着大型银行竞相保持在技术曲线上的领先地位，华尔街在人工智能上下了重注，并投入了数十亿美元。

生成式人工智能正在影响从交易大厅到后台、从工作流程到工作场所文化的方方面面。 它正在改变软件工程师的含义、初级银行家的脱颖而出方式，甚至是最高管理层内部的角色。 这种转变似乎才刚刚开始。

然而，尽管取得了所有这些宣称的进步，分析师们仍然不断向高管们提出有关回报和安全的问题，因为整个行业越来越担心在人工智能上的巨额支出是否合理。 尽管目前利用这项技术是赌注——摩根大通首席执行官杰米·戴蒙表示，他的银行并不是“唯一从人工智能中受益”，因为现在每个人都在使用它——但公司战略之间仍然存在等级差异。

以下是我们对华尔街最大银行如何拥抱人工智能的了解。

摩根大通

在每年近 200 亿美元的技术预算的帮助下，这家美国最大的银行正在投入大量精力，以确保自己成为人工智能领域的先行者。 戴蒙此前曾表示，他要赢得人工智能军备竞赛，他认为摩根大通 20 亿美元的人工智能投资已经与其节省成本相匹配。

据《商业内幕》报道，该公司正在密切关注数万名工程师如何使用人工智能。 一个仪表板跟踪开发人员使用 GitHub Copilot 的程度，并将他们分为“轻度”、“重度”或“非”用户。 该银行还更新了工程师的目标，根据公司内联网上的帖子，工程师现在希望通过采用人工智能来“推动卓越”。

今年 7 月，该公司人工智能主管 Teresa Heitsenrether 在银行工作了 40 年后宣布退休，并重新洗牌了技术领导层。 摩根大通当时表示，随着公司从专注于人工智能基础设施转向业务计划，该公司正在重组其全公司首席数据和分析办公室。 据 Business Insider 审阅的一份内部备忘录显示，摩根大通在 2 月份重组了其商业和投资银行，以“最大限度地发挥人工智能的影响”。 该部门的每项主要业务现在都向 CIB 新任命的首席运营官盖伊·哈拉米什 (Guy Halamish) 汇报。

戴蒙在第二季度财报电话会议上表示，他的银行已经拥有近 1,000 个用例，从欺诈保护到营销再到笔记。 该银行已向超过 200,000 名员工推出了其专有的 genAI 平台，旨在为从编码员到投资组合经理的每个人重新设计工作流程。

该银行的人工智能工作正在影响其直接员工队伍之外的人员。 摩根大通资产管理部门宣布，计划今年停止长期以来在美国使用外部代理顾问进行股东投票的做法。 该公司正在推出一个名为 Proxy IQ 的内部人工智能平台来取代外部人类顾问，以支持股东决策。

高盛

高盛今年在技术支出上投入了 60 亿美元，但该银行首席执行官戴维·所罗门 (David Solomon) 在 10 月份表示，他希望投入更多。 他希望自己的资产至少达到 80 亿美元，但“我负担不起，因为我必须提供回报。”

所罗门在他的年度信中鼓励今年的实习生尝试人工智能工具，“以增强团队的工作流程”；公司其他部门在 10 月份得到了关于人工智能影响的明确声明，当时向员工发出了一份备忘录，宣布跨银行计划的第三次迭代 OneGS。 备忘录称，该计划将利用人工智能来提高公司效率，减缓招聘速度，并导致“有限减少”职位。

与同行一样，高盛一直在向所有员工推出工具，包括内部人工智能助理。 首席信息官 Marco Argenti 告诉《商业内幕》，他对衡量团队使用人工智能工具的速度比个人使用情况更感兴趣。 Marco 在 2 月份告诉 CNBC，该银行一直在与 Anthropic 合作开发可以自动化许多内部功能的人工智能代理。 他说，该项目的重点是交易和交易的会计以及客户入职。

花旗集团

花旗正试图在人工智能游戏中赢得员工的支持高于一切。 该公司负责监督该银行 120 亿美元技术预算的技术主管蒂姆·瑞安 (Tim Ryan) 告诉《商业内幕》，他认为公司需要“指标和自豪感”的结合。 花旗采取自下而上的方法将人工智能嵌入其整个业务线，4,000 名员工接受了人工智能管理员的培训。

花旗首席执行官简·弗雷泽 (Jane Fraser) 在该行 2026 年财报电话会议上表示，花旗近 90% 的员工都在使用人工智能工具。 今年，该银行推出了人工智能财富顾问，并开始扩大代理人的使用。

与一些竞争对手不同，花旗不会衡量员工的人工智能使用情况；相反，它衡量“大事”并鼓励员工使用满足其需求的最低成本模式。

2025 年 6 月，该银行加倍坚定其人工智能雄心，任命新的领导层来掌管其技术转型。

富国银行

《商业内幕》采访了该银行人工智能主管 Saul Van Beurden，了解人工智能如何推动该银行资产上限后的增长。

该公司的人工智能架构采用“中心辐射”模型，以 Van Beurden 的小团队作为中心枢纽，每个业务线的生成式人工智能主管作为辐射。 他说，人工智能代理正在成为一些影响最大的用例的核心。

当《商业内幕》三月份采访范伯登时，该银行并没有强制要求员工使用人工智能。

7 月，富国银行宣布为其财务顾问配备“人工智能队友”，据称这将有助于增加日常活动。 首席执行官 Charles Scharf 此前曾表示，生成式 AI 工具已经使该银行工程师的工作效率提高了 35%。

富国银行还在 2026 年初任命亚马逊网络服务高管 Faraz Shafiq 领导人工智能产品和解决方案，这是华尔街一系列备受瞩目的科技挖角事件中的最新一起。

美国银行

美国银行的科技雄心得到了 2025 年 130 亿美元科技预算的支持，首席执行官布莱恩·莫伊尼汉 (Brian Moynihan) 表示，人工智能已经嵌入到整个公司，从消费者银行业务到机构客户。

该银行在 7 月份的第二季度财报中表示，该公司已批准 300 多个人工智能和机器学习案例，并且至少有 34 个生成式人工智能用例得到全面部署。 财富、投资银行和工程领域的员工拥有专门的工具。

美国银行 3 月份表示，自 2018 年推出该工具以来，客户与该银行的虚拟助理 Erica 的互动次数已超过 32 亿次。

莫伊尼汉在 2 月份的一次会议上发表讲话时，阐述了该银行使用人工智能的一些模型。 他说，有一个模型可以发布每日市场报告，还有其他模型可以帮助起草宣传手册。

摩根士丹利

摩根士丹利与 OpenAI 有着多年的合作伙伴关系，并自 2024 年起为财务顾问配备了生成式 AI。

首席财务官 Sharon Yeshaya 在去年的财报电话会议上揭开了该公司在人工智能方面取得的一些进展的帷幕。 据《商业内幕》此前报道，她重点介绍了 DevGen.AI，该工具从 1 月到 6 月为开发人员节省了超过 280,000 小时（即 11,666 天）的时间，而此前他们本该专门用于破译过时的代码。

Parable（一种分析和总结数据的交互式工具）和 LeadIQ（一种人工智能驱动的潜在客户分配平台，可将其工作场所和自主平台的用户与银行的财务顾问进行匹配）也在电话会议中受到关注。

摩根士丹利 2025 年对实习生进行的一项调查也让我们了解了人工智能对于该行业最年轻的实习生来说是多么受欢迎和有用。 ChatGPT 是他们迄今为止最喜欢的工具，72% 的摩根士丹利实习生表示他们每天或每周使用几次。 该银行很早就与 ChatGPT 制造商 OpenAI 建立了合作伙伴关系。
